fetch_recipe: GET the recorded url exactly (raw Internet Archive id_ form) with no Accept-Encoding request header, or with Accept-Encoding: identity, and no automatic decoding (for example curl -s -o FILE URL, without --compressed), then hash the bytes as received. A client that accepts gzip can receive an on-the-fly gzip body with different bytes, and a decoding client unpacks bodies that the archive stores compressed.

rows.role_title: Deputy President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: The Presidency's media advisory of 27 February 2018 states that the new members of the National Executive, including the Deputy President of the Republic, Mr David Mabuza, were appointed by President Cyril Ramaphosa on Monday, 26 February 2018.

rows.role_title: Deputy President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: The same advisory invites the media to the swearing-in of the new Deputy President, Cabinet Ministers and Deputy Ministers 'today, 27 February 2018' at 16h00 at Tuynhuys, Parliament, Cape Town (the opening sentence names the Good Hope Chambers).
